args: echo M22_BEGIN; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; run-as com.cooper.lithic.debug sh -c 'test ! -e no_backup/active-generation && test ! -e no_backup/generations && echo DEFAULT_ROOT_ABSENT; find no_backup -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 2 -type f; if [ -d databases ]; then find databases -maxdepth 1 -type f; else echo NO_DATABASES_DIR; fi'; ps -A -o PID,UID,NAME | grep -E "com.cooper.lithic.debug(:| |$)" || true; echo M22_END
